verifications.claim: The federal income tax filing deadline for 2025 returns is April 15, 2026, for most taxpayers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'For 2025 returns filed in 2026, the last day to file taxes is April 15, 2026.'; R3: 'April 15 – Individual taxes due'; R7: 'Calendar year filers (most common) File on: April 15, 2026'; R9: 'April 15, 2026, is the deadline for 2025 tax returns for individuals.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the deadline for 2025 returns as April 15, 2026, for individuals/calendar year filers.

verifications.claim: An automatic 6-month extension to file extends the deadline to October 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'automatic six-month extension ... due date to file with extension is Oct. 15.'; R7: 'automatic 6-month extension of time to file'; R9: 'extension until October 15, 2026'; R10: 'until October 15 to file'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm automatic 6-month extension moves filing deadline to October 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: An extension to file is not an extension to pay.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'an extension only gives you more time to submit your tax return forms, not more time to pay your taxes.'; R7: 'An extension of time to file is not an extension of time to pay.'; R10: 'The extension is only for filing your return.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements in multiple sources clarify extension applies only to filing, not payment.

verifications.claim: Taxes owed are still due by April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'payments are due on Tax Day ... April 15'; R4: 'tax extensions are only for filing a tax return and don't provide extra time to pay'; R9: 'you are still required to pay any taxes you may owe by the April deadline.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm payments due by April 15, 2026, regardless of filing extension.

verifications.claim: The deadline for individual returns is April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the last day to file taxes is April 15, 2026.'; R3: 'April 15 – Individual taxes due'; R7: 'File on: April 15, 2026'; R9: 'April 15, 2026 - Tax day.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation for individual returns deadline as April 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: The deadline for extension to file is October 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'due date to file with extension is Oct. 15.'; R3: 'October 15 – Tax due date for individuals who filed for an extension'; R9: 'October 15, 2026 - Deadline to file your extended 2025 tax return.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify October 15, 2026, as extended filing deadline.

verifications.claim: The deadline for partnerships and S-Corps is March 16, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'March 16 – Partnerships and S corporations file 2025 calendar year returns'; R9: 'March 16, 2026 - Tax returns are due for ... partnerships and S corporations.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state March 16, 2026, for partnerships and S-Corps.

verifications.label: OMITTED
